item: Failing test: 'glitch: offside given from a corner (pipeline)' in /home/user/Fifa/tests/scenario/rul-08-pipeline.test.ts
detail: Now fails with 'expected 5 to be 7' at readyRestart (line 143). The helper assumes that slot 7, standing next to the spot, becomes the restart taker. src/sim/rules/corner.ts was changed at 18:39, after offside.ts, and its pickCornerTaker now chooses the team's best crosser (slot 5). So this breakage comes from a corner.ts change, not from offside.ts or a stub. I copied the file to the scratchpad and replaced only that taker assertion: all 9 pipeline tests then pass, corner glitch included, so offside.ts behaves correctly. The test still has to be fixed. For CORNER, assert only that the taker is valid and not the receiver, or use pickCornerTaker. Until then the suite fails: 1 failed and 179 passed out of 180.

item: Wrong behaviour: a deliberate play by the defending team after a blocked or parried on-target shot does not reset offside when the same player made both contacts (src/sim/rules/offside.ts playedDeliberately/touchedBetween, lines 184-205)
detail:
A deflection, block, parry or tip is meant to be followed by a reset when the defending team next plays the ball deliberately. The code decides whether a contact is the 'first contact after the shot' (a save, flags kept) using touchedBetween(passTick, tick) over players[i].lastTouchTick. That value only keeps each player's latest touch, and ball.shotTick is never reset. So when the defender or keeper who made the first contact plays the ball again, his earlier touch has been overwritten. That second play is then treated as a 'save' as well, the flags stay set, and it also starts no new snapshot. I confirmed three failing cases with scratch tests that call offsideTick and use the real applyKick, recordTouch and takePossession:
(a) Shot on target (onTarget=1) with the striker flagged. A defender makes a DEFLECTION, then the same defender makes a CLEARANCE that hits the flagged striker (recordTouch). Result: OFFSIDE is given; the expected result is none.
(b) The ball bounces off a defender (touch without a kick), then the same defender plays a CLEARANCE and the striker takes possession. Result: OFFSIDE.
(c) The keeper plays GK_PARRY, then the same keeper plays a CLEARANCE and the striker takes possession. Result: OFFSIDE.
The existing tests only cover a different player making the second, deliberate contact. A related case: after an on-target shot hits the post with no touch, the first defender's deliberate clearance is also classed as a save. Fix suggestion: once a save or deflection is accepted, mark it in the state, for example by moving o.passTick to the save tick so that shotTick !== passTick from then on. Then add a regression test for a block followed by a clearance from the same player.

item: Minor/untested: a free kick taken by the RUL-11 safety net (forceRestartKick) is never judged for offside
detail: forceRestartKick is called from restartTick in rulesTick after offsideTick, and also from watchdogTick. It calls applyKick in FREE_KICK phase after offsideTick has already run for that tick. On the next tick the phase is IN_PLAY and lastKickTick !== tick, so no snapshot is taken. This affects only free kicks that time out (restartTimeoutTicks 720). The normal path, where actionsTick calls applyKick, works and is tested. The cause is how this module's timing interacts with restart.ts. A brief note or a lead decision is enough here; a code change is not essential.
